heading_fil: Ang BHW Eligibility (BHWE) sa Civil Service
heading_en: BHW Eligibility (BHWE) in the Civil Service
display_fil:
BHWE: akreditasyon; hindi bababa sa dalawang taon ng kolehiyo; limang taon ng tuloy-tuloy, aktibo at full-time na boluntaryong serbisyo; satisfactory na record.
Bibilangin lang ang limang taon mula nang maakreditado, at kung walang bayad maliban sa honorarium.
Tiyakin sa CSC ang dokumento at lahat ng kondisyon.
display_en:
BHWE: accreditation; at least two years of college; five years of continuous, active, full-time voluntary service; a satisfactory record.
The five years count only after accreditation, and only if unpaid except for an honorarium.
Confirm documentation and all conditions with CSC.

narration_fil:
May hiwalay na kwalipikasyon para sa BHW Eligibility sa ilalim ng Civil Service Commission (CSC Resolution No. 99-2845). Apat na kondisyon ang kailangan: akreditado ng local health board; nakatapos ng minimum na dalawang (2) taon sa kolehiyo tungo sa isang degree; aktibo at boluntaryong naglilingkod nang tuloy-tuloy at full time sa loob ng limang (5) taon o higit pa bilang accredited BHW; at may satisfactory service bilang accredited BHW sa komunidad.

Bibilangin lang ang limang taon kung boluntaryo ang serbisyo — walang sahod o ibang bayad maliban sa honorarium sa buong panahon — at mula lamang nang akreditado na ang BHW. Hindi binibilang ang serbisyo bago ang 20 Pebrero 1995, nang maaprubahan ang RA 7883. Maaari pa ring mag-qualify ang BHW na naka-job order o contract of service.

Hindi ito parehong bagay sa pangkalahatang akreditasyon — mas mataas ang hinihingi nito, at para ito sa mga BHW na nais magkaroon ng opisyal na eligibility sa serbisyo sibil.
narration_en:
There is a separate qualification for BHW Eligibility under the Civil Service Commission (CSC Resolution No. 99-2845). Four conditions are required: accredited by the local health board; completed a minimum of two (2) years of college leading to a degree; actively and voluntarily serving continuously, full time, for five (5) years or more as an accredited BHW; and having a satisfactory service record as an accredited BHW in the community.

The five years count only if the service was voluntary — no salary or other pay except an honorarium for the whole period — and only from the time the BHW was already accredited. Service before 20 February 1995, when RA 7883 was approved, does not count. A BHW hired under a job order or contract of service can still qualify.

This is not the same thing as general accreditation — it asks for more, and it is for BHWs who want official eligibility in the civil service.
